author: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal
description: Major flooding associated with extreme rainfall across Kathmandu Valley and surrounding areas from September 27-29, 2024.
evidenceSource: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal
summary: Rainfall triggered flooding across the Kathmandu Valley with 239.7 mm in 24 hours recorded at Tribhuvan International Airport. The floods and landslides caused 56 reported deaths within the valley while preliminary assessments identified more than 2,100 severely affected homes in riverside settlements. Nationwide, the disaster caused 250 deaths and left 18 people missing according to Nepal's disaster authority.

description: Heavy monsoon rainfall on August 8, 2023 caused river flooding and inundation in Bhaktapur. Reported affected locations included Hanuman Ghat, Ram Mandir, Shanti Niketan School, and Siddhi Memorial Women and Children Hospital. DHM recorded 77.1 mm of rainfall at Bhaktapur and 100.4 mm at Changu Narayan on August 8. Event impacts were documented by The Kathmandu Post: https://kathmandupost.com/bhaktapur/2023/08/08/heavy-downpour-inundates-bhaktapur-settlements. Sponsor photographs remain pending access and verification.
evidenceSource: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal; The Kathmandu Post
summary: Floodwaters affected several areas of Bhaktapur including Hanuman Ghat, Ram Mandir, Shanti Niketan School and Siddhi Memorial Women and Children Hospital. Rainfall measurements reached 77.1 mm at Bhaktapur and 100.4 mm at Changu Narayan. The flooding reached community facilities, demonstrating the intense monsoon rainfalls impact on residential areas and healthcare access.

description: A flash flood was reported in Samakhushi, Kathmandu, on July 24, 2023. Onlinekhabar reported that a child was swept away and remained missing at the time of publication. Associated sponsor observation SPONSOR-004 was corrected to July 24, 2023 based on the article. The original sponsor spreadsheet recorded July 24, 2024. The photograph accompanying the Onlinekhabar article is illustrative and is not verified as depicting the July 24, 2023 Samakhushi flood. Its source filename references a 2020 Kapan flood.
summary: In July 2023, a flash flood was reported in the Samakhushi area of Kathmandu. A 13 year old body was tragically swept away in the flood and his body was finally recovered on August 3, 2023. Incidents in which children are swept away and killed during Kathmandu Valley floods occur every few years.

location: Tripureshwor, Thapathali and Sanepa, Kathmandu Valley
description: Heavy rainfall caused flooding along the Bagmati River in Kathmandu Valley on August 8, 2023. Setopati documented flooding in the Tripureshwor, Thapathali and Sanepa areas, including photographic evidence. Associated sponsor observations SPONSOR-023 and SPONSOR-024 were corrected to August 8, 2023 based on the Setopati report. The original sponsor spreadsheet recorded August 8, 2024.
summary: Heavy monsoon rainfall caused the Bagmati River to overflow into settlements in Thapathali, Tripureshwor, and Sanepa. Flooding across the valley required 33 rescues and left two people injured. The flooding highlighted the exposure of densely populated riverside communities with roughly 145 families living in Thapathali's Paurakhi settlement. One article from The Rising Nepal blames corrupt land allotment practices, increased urbanization near rivers, and sand mining for increasing flood frequency and intensity.
